name: Eat
overview: Scripture reveals God's provision and guidance concerning what humans may eat, beginning with His original provision of plants and fruit for food as stated in Genesis 1:29 and 2:16. After the flood, God expanded this provision to include every living moving thing as meat (Genesis 9:3), demonstrating His sovereign authority over creation and sustenance. The Lord also provided manna from heaven to sustain Israel in the wilderness, testing their obedience to His law through daily portions (Exodus 16:4, 16:35). Additionally, God gave specific instructions about clean and unclean foods, as introduced in Leviticus 11:1, indicating His concern for holiness and obedience in dietary practices.
